reasons.correctness: Repository finder, closeStaleResolvedTickets(int) with @Transactional, and the cron job's enabled, olderThanDays and cron properties and defaults all match the interface. Failures are logged, not thrown. Hidden acceptance tests pass 4/4; build is green.
reasons.convention_fit: The @Scheduled closeStaleTickets() has no @SchedulerLock; SchedulerLock is imported but unused, so the job runs on every instance. The new domain logic in SupportTicketService has no unit test, and the run command used -Dtest=X instead of the class name.
reasons.design_fit: Selection logic sits in the service and the query in the repository; the job only delegates, and the change is small. Minor smell: the CronJob is placed in the services package, while the example read uses a cron package.
reasons.test_quality: StaleTicketCloseCronJobUnitTest covers the enabled, disabled and exception-swallowed paths with MockitoExtension. The service's cutoff, status transition and save count are untested. The file holds 3 tests, but the reported result is 2/2.
reasons.graph_use: One trivial query (MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.file_path LIMIT 1) found nothing specific. No query located the support/ticket package, its dependents or an existing scheduled job. The DeferredDeletionCronJob example was read directly.
